text: Which statement generates a list of Leads and Contacts that have a field with the phrase 'ACME'?

options.text: List<sObject> searchList = [FIND 'ACME' IN ALL FIELDS RETURNING Contact, Lead];
Map<sObject> searchList = [FIND 'ACME' IN ALL FIELDS RETURNING Contact, Lead];
List<List<sObject>> searchList = [SELECT Name, ID FROM Contact, Lead WHERE Name like '%ACME%'];
List<List<sObject>> searchList = [FIND 'ACME*' IN ALL FIELDS RETURNING Contact, Lead];

explanation: A SOSL query searches across multiple objects and always returns a List<List<sObject>>, one inner list per object in the RETURNING clause, so the FIND 'ACME*' IN ALL FIELDS RETURNING Contact, Lead statement is correct. Assigning SOSL results to a flat List<sObject> or to a Map does not compile. SOQL cannot query two objects in one FROM clause, so the SELECT statement is invalid.

text: Which scenario is valid for execution by unit tests?

options.text: Generate a Visualforce PDF with getContentAsPDF().

Load data from a remote site with a callout.

text: A developer is tasked with building a custom Lightning web component to collect Contact information. The form will be shared among many different types of users in the org. lightning-input-field
force-input-field

text: Universal Containers decides to use purely declarative development to build out a new Salesforce application. Which two options can be used to build out the business logic layer for this application?

options.text: Record-Triggered Flow
Batch Jobs
Validation Rules
Remote Actions

text: A developer created these three Rollup Summary fields in the custom object, Project__c: Total_Timesheets__c, Total_Approved_Timesheets__c, Total_Rejected_Timesheet__c. The developer is asked to create a new field that shows the ratio between rejected and approved timesheets for a new field. Which should the developer use to implement the business requirement in order to minimize maintenance overhead?

options.text: Apex trigger
Roll-up summary field
Record-triggered flow
Formula field

A roll-up summary field can only COUNT, SUM, MIN or MAX child records, not compute a ratio of other fields. A trigger or record-triggered flow could store the value but adds unnecessary maintenance.

Salesforce CLI
Visual Studio Code
Developer Console

text: Which exception type cannot be caught?

options.text: A custom exception
LimitException
NoAccessException
CalloutException

explanation: System.LimitException is thrown when a governor limit is exceeded and it cannot be caught; the transaction is terminated immediately. Custom exceptions, NoAccessException and CalloutException can all be handled in a try/catch block.

text: A developer created a child Lightning web component nested inside a parent Lightning web component. The parent component needs to pass a string value to the child component. In which two ways can this be accomplished?

options.text: The parent component can invoke a public method in the child component.
The parent component can use a public property to pass the data to the child component.
The parent component can use the Apex controller class to send data to the child component.
The parent component can use a custom event to pass the data to the child component.

explanation: Data flows down the component tree through the child's public API: the parent can set an @api property in markup or call an @api method on the child. Custom events travel up from child to parent, not down, and an Apex controller is not a mechanism for passing values between components.

text: A developer is asked to update code that requires them to validate input into a trigger. Which Apex Control Flow Statement should the developer use?

options.text: Conditional (If-Else) Statement
While Loop
Switch Statement
For Loop

explanation: Validating input means checking a condition and branching, for example calling addError() when a value is invalid, which is exactly what an if-else statement does. Loops iterate rather than validate, and a switch statement matches a single value against fixed cases, which is less suited to general validation conditions.

text: A developer wants to send an outbound message when a record meets a specific criteria. Which two features satisfy this use case?

options.text: Flow Builder can be used to check the record criteria and send an outbound message.
Approval Process can be used to check the record criteria and send an outbound message without Apex code.
Next Best Action can be used to check the record criteria and send an outbound message.
Entitlement Process can be used to check the record criteria and send an outbound message without Apex code.

explanation: Record-triggered flows can evaluate entry criteria and include an outbound message action, and approval processes support outbound messages as approval, rejection or recall actions without any Apex. Next Best Action surfaces recommendations to users, and entitlement process milestone actions do not send outbound messages.

All triggers must have some test coverage.
All Visual flows must have at least 1% test coverage.
All custom objects must have visibility set to a value other than In Development.

explanation: Deploying Apex to production requires at least 75% overall code coverage, and every trigger must have at least some (1%) coverage. Flow coverage is not required for deployment, and custom objects do not need a deployment status other than In Development to be deployed.

A roll-up summary field on the Opportunity object

text: Universal Containers hires a developer to build a custom search page to help users find the Accounts they want. Users will be able to search on Name, Description, and a custom comments field. Which consideration should the developer be aware of when deciding between SOQL and SOSL?

options.text: SOSL is able to return more records.
SOQL is able to return more records.
SOSL is faster for text searches.
SOQL is faster for text searches.

explanation: SOQL can return up to 50,000 records per transaction while a SOSL query returns at most 2,000, so SOQL can return more records. SOSL uses the search index, which makes it faster for text searches across multiple fields like Name, Description and a comments field. The opposite statements are false.

text: Universal Containers needs to create a custom user interface component that allows users to enter information about their accounts. The component should be able to validate the user input before saving the information to the database. What is the best technology to create this component?

Lightning Web Components
Flow
VUE JavaScript framework

Paused Flow Interviews component
Developer Console

options.text: Declarative customizations automatically generate test classes.
Declarative customizations automatically update with each Salesforce release.
Declarative customizations generally require less maintenance.
Declarative customizations cannot generate runtime errors.

text: A team of many developers work in their own individual orgs that have the same configuration as the production org. Which type of org is best suited for this scenario?

text: A developer has an integer variable called maxAttempts. The developer needs to ensure that once maxAttempts is initialized, it preserves its value for the length of the Apex transaction; while being able to share the variable's state between trigger executions. How should the developer declare maxAttempts to meet these requirements?

options.text: Declare maxAttempts as a constant using the static and final keywords.
Declare maxAttempts as a member variable on the trigger definition.

explanation: A static final variable is initialized once and keeps that value for the whole transaction, and because it is static it is shared across every trigger execution in that transaction. Add @isTest(seeAllData=true) at the start of the unit test class.
Create test data before Test.startTest() in the unit test.

Topic and action instructions are supported in multiple languages.

Language support may differ by agent type.

text: A developer is creating an app that contains multiple Lightning web components. One of the child components is used for navigation purposes. When a user clicks a button called Next in the child, the parent component must be alerted so it can navigate to the next page. How should this be accomplished?

options.text: Update a property on the parent.
Create a custom event.
Fire a notification.
Call a method in the Apex controller.

explanation: Child-to-parent communication in LWC uses events: the child dispatches a CustomEvent such as next, and the parent listens with an onnext handler in its markup. A child cannot directly set a parent's property, notifications are for showing messages to users, and an Apex call does not notify a component.

text: Which two settings must be defined in order to update a record of a junction object?

Read/Write access on the primary relationship
Read/Write access on the secondary relationship
Read/Write access on the junction object

To edit a junction record, the user needs Read/Write access on both the primary and the secondary master records. Read access alone on the primary is not enough, and junction objects have no independent sharing setting of their own.

text: A company has a custom object, Order__c, that has a required, unique external ID field called Order_Number__c. Which statement should be used to perform the DML necessary to insert new records and update existing records in a list of Order__c records using the external ID field?

merge orders;

text: What is a benefit of developing applications in a multi-tenant environment?

options.text: Unlimited processing power and memory
Enforced unit testing and code coverage best practices
Preconfigured storage for big data
Access to predefined computing resources

explanation: In a multi-tenant environment, every tenant shares a managed pool of predefined computing resources, so developers do not have to provision infrastructure. text: A developer is creating a Lightning web component to show a list of sales records. The Sales Representative user should be able to see the commission field on each record. Use Lightning Data Service to get the collection of sales records.
Use WITH SECURITY_ENFORCED in the SOQL that fetches the data for the component.
Use Lightning Locker Service to enforce sharing rules and field-level security.

text: Which three statements are accurate about debug logs?

options.text: Debug log levels are cumulative, where FINE log level includes all events logged at the DEBUG, INFO, WARN, and ERROR levels.

text: What are three ways for a developer to execute tests in an org?

options.text: Tooling API
Salesforce DX

Setup Menu
Bulk API

text: What are two use cases for executing Anonymous Apex code?

options.text: To schedule an Apex class to run periodically
To delete 15,000 inactive Accounts in a single transaction after a deployment
To run a batch Apex class to update all Contacts
To add unit test code coverage to an org

Deleting 15,000 records in one transaction exceeds the 10,000 DML row limit, and anonymous code does not count toward code coverage.

text: An Opportunity needs to have an amount rolled up from a custom object that is not in a master-detail relationship. How can this be achieved?

options.text: Use the Metadata API to create real-time roll-up summaries.
Write a trigger on the child object and use an aggregate function to sum the amount for all related child objects under the Opportunity.
Write a trigger on the Opportunity object and use tree sorting to sum the amount for all related child objects under the Opportunity.
Use the Streaming API to create real-time roll-up summaries.

explanation: Without master-detail, roll-up summary fields are not available, so a trigger on the child object that runs an aggregate SOQL query such as SUM(Amount__c) grouped by Opportunity and updates the parent is the standard approach. A trigger on Opportunity would not fire when child records change, and neither the Metadata API nor the Streaming API calculates roll-ups.

text: A developer created a trigger on the Account object. While testing the trigger, the developer sees the error message 'Maximum trigger depth exceeded'. What could be the possible causes?

options.text: The trigger is getting executed multiple times.
The trigger is too long and should be refactored into a helper class.
The trigger does not have sufficient code coverage.
The developer does not have the correct user permission.

explanation: 'Maximum trigger depth exceeded' means the trigger is firing recursively, for example by updating the same records that fire it, until it passes the recursion limit of 16 levels. A static Boolean or set of processed Ids is the usual fix. Trigger length, code coverage and user permissions do not cause this error.

text: Universal Containers wants to ensure that all new leads created in the system have a valid email address. text: While working in a sandbox, an Apex test fails when run in the Test Runner. However, executing the Apex logic in the Execute Anonymous window succeeds with no exceptions or errors. Why did the method fail in the sandbox test framework but succeed in the Developer Console?

options.text: The test method relies on existing data in the sandbox.
The test method has a syntax error in the code.
The test method is calling an @future method.
The test method does not use System.runAs to execute as a specific user.

explanation: By default, test methods cannot see existing org data, so logic that queries records already in the sandbox finds nothing in a test but works in Execute Anonymous, which runs against real data. A syntax error would prevent compilation entirely, @future methods run fine in tests (inside Test.startTest()/stopTest()), and System.runAs is not required.

text: A developer must perform a complex SQL query that joins two objects in a Lightning component. How can the Lightning component execute the query?

Use the Salesforce Streaming API to perform the SQL query.

text: A developer created a trigger on the Account object and wants to test if the trigger is properly bulkified. text: Universal Containers has an order system that uses an Order Number to identify an order for customers and service agents. Order records will be imported into Salesforce. How should the Order Number field be defined in Salesforce?

Lookup

text: If Apex code executes inside the execute() method of an Apex class when implementing the Batchable interface, which two statements are true regarding governor limits?

text: A custom picklist field, 'Food_Preference__c', exists on a custom object. The picklist contains the following options: 'Vegan', 'Kosher', 'No Preference'. text: A developer needs to confirm that a Contact trigger works correctly without changing the organization's data. What should the developer do to test the Contact trigger?

text: Which Apex class contains methods to return the amount of resources that have been used for a particular governor, such as the number of DML statements?

Renaming or replacing picklists

text: A developer has the following requirements: - Calculate the total amount on an Order. - Calculate the line amount for each Line Item based on quantity selected and price. - Move Line Items to a different Order if a Line Item is not in stock. The OrderHelper class is a utility class that contains business logic for processing orders. Consider the following code snippet:

text: Which two characteristics are true for Lightning Web Component custom events?

text: Assuming that name is a String obtained by an <apex:inputText> tag on a Visualforce page, which two SOQL queries performed are safe from SOQL injection?

text: While developing an Apex class with custom search functionality that will be launched from a Lightning Web Component, how can the developer ensure only records accessible to the currently logged in user are displayed?

Master-detail field on Bug__c to Account
Junction object between Bug__c and Account

Write a class that extends 'HTTPCalloutMock'.
Write a class that implements 'HTTPCalloutMock'.

explanation: Tests cannot make real callouts, so for HTTP/REST callouts the developer writes a class that implements the HttpCalloutMock interface, returns a fake HttpResponse from respond(), and registers it with Test.setMock(). WebServiceMock is for SOAP callouts generated from WSDL, and both are interfaces, so they are implemented rather than extended.

text: Universal Containers (UC) is developing a process for their sales teams that requires all sales reps to go through a set of scripted steps with each new customer they create. In the first step of collecting information, UC's ERP system must be checked via a REST endpoint to see if the customer exists. If the customer exists, the data must be presented to the sales rep in Salesforce. Which two should a developer implement to satisfy the requirements?

options.text: Trigger
Invocable method
Future method
Flow

explanation: A screen flow provides the scripted, step-by-step experience for the sales reps, and an Apex invocable method called from the flow can make the REST callout to the ERP and return the data for display on the next screen. A trigger runs on record saves and cannot guide users through steps, and a future method runs asynchronously, so it cannot return data to the user in real time.

text: A developer must provide custom user interfaces when users edit a Contact in either Salesforce Classic or Lightning Experience. What should the developer use to override the Contact's Edit button and provide this functionality?

options.text: Visualforce page in Salesforce Classic and a Lightning page in Lightning Experience
Lightning page in Salesforce Classic and a Visualforce page in Lightning Experience
Lightning component in Salesforce Classic and a Lightning component in Lightning Experience
Visualforce page in Salesforce Classic and a Lightning component in Lightning Experience

explanation: Exam key: a Visualforce page in Classic and a Lightning page in Lightning Experience. Note: standard button overrides in Classic accept Visualforce pages, while Lightning Experience overrides accept Visualforce pages or Lightning components (Aura components implementing lightning:actionOverride), not Lightning App Builder pages. The documented answer is a Visualforce page in Classic and a Lightning component in Lightning Experience. Lightning components cannot override buttons in Classic.
reviewNote: Key appears incorrect: Edit overrides in Lightning Experience use a Lightning component (or Visualforce), not a Lightning page; documented answer is D.

text: What should a developer use to script the deployment and unit test execution as part of continuous integration?

options.text: Salesforce CLI
Developer Console
Execute Anonymous
VS Code

explanation: The Salesforce CLI runs from the command line, so CI tools can script deployments (sf project deploy start) and test runs (sf apex run test) automatically. The Developer Console, Execute Anonymous, and VS Code are interactive tools that cannot be scripted as part of a CI pipeline.

text:
A developer considers the following snippet of code: 
Boolean iOK = false;
Integer x;
String theString = 'Hello';
if (iOK == false && theString == 'Hello'){
    x=1;
} else if (iOK == true && theString == 'Hello'){
    x=2;
} else if (iOK != null && theString == 'Hello'){
    x=3;
} else {
    x=4;
}
Based on this code, what is the value of x?
explanation: iOK is false and theString equals 'Hello', so the first condition iOK == false && theString == 'Hello' is true and x is set to 1. Once an if branch matches, the else if and else branches are skipped, so x is never set to 2, 3, or 4.

text: A PrimaryId__c custom field exists on the Candidate__c custom object. The field is used to store each candidate's id number and is marked as Unique in the schema definition. As part of a data enrichment process, Universal Containers has a CSV file that contains updated data for all candidates in the system. The file contains each Candidate's primary id as a data point. Universal Containers wants to upload this information into Salesforce, while ensuring all data rows are correctly mapped to a candidate in the system. Which technique should the developer implement to streamline the data upload?

options.text: Upload the CSV into a custom object related to Candidate__c.
Create a before save flow to correctly map the records.
Create a before insert trigger to correctly map the records.
Update the PrimaryId__c field definition to mark it as an External Id.

explanation: Marking PrimaryId__c as an External ID lets Data Loader or the Data Import Wizard upsert the CSV by matching each row to the existing Candidate__c with the same id, with no Salesforce record Ids needed. Staging the data in another object, or writing a flow or trigger to do the matching, adds unnecessary work for something the platform does natively.

text:
Considering the following code snippet: 
public static void insertAccounts(List<Account> theseAccounts){
    for(Account thisAccount: theseAccounts){
        if(thisAccount.website == null){
            thisAccount.website = 'https://www.demo.com';
        }
    }
    update theseAccounts;
}
When the code executes, a DML exception is thrown. How should a developer modify the code to ensure exceptions are handled gracefully?

options.text: Implement the upsert DML statement.
Remove null items from the list of Accounts.
Implement Change Data Capture.
Implement a try/catch block for the DML.

explanation: Wrapping the update in a try/catch block that catches DmlException lets the code handle the error, for example by logging it or showing a friendly message, instead of failing the transaction with an unhandled exception. Switching to upsert or removing null items might avoid one specific cause but does not handle exceptions, and Change Data Capture publishes change events rather than handling errors.
reviewNote: Source text is partly garbled: first option read "Implement the 'up**** DML statement'"; restored to "Implement the upsert DML statement" and removed stray backticks from the options.

text:
How many Accounts will be inserted by the following block of code? 
for(Integer i=0; i<500; i++) {
    Account a = new Account(Name='New Account ' + i);
    insert a;
}
explanation: Each loop iteration issues a separate insert, and a transaction allows only 150 DML statements, so the 151st insert throws an uncatchable System.LimitException. The whole transaction is rolled back, including the 150 inserts that had succeeded, so 0 Accounts are saved. Collecting the records in a list and inserting them once would insert all 500.

text: The Job_Application__c custom object has a field that is a master-detail relationship to the Contact object, where the Contact object is the master. As part of a feature implementation, a developer needs to retrieve a list containing Contact records where the related Account Industry is 'Technology', while also retrieving the Contact's Job_Application__c records. Based on the object's relationships, what is the most efficient statement to retrieve the list of Contacts?

options.text: [SELECT Id, (SELECT Id FROM Job_Application__c) FROM Contact WHERE Account.Industry = 'Technology'];
[SELECT Id, (SELECT Id FROM Job_Application__c) FROM Contact WHERE Accounts.Industry = 'Technology'];
[SELECT Id, (SELECT Id FROM Job_Application__r) FROM Contact WHERE Accounts.Industry = 'Technology'];
[SELECT Id, (SELECT Id FROM Job_Application_s) FROM Contact WHERE Accounts.Industry = 'Technology'];

explanation: Exam key: D. A parent-to-child subquery must use the child relationship name, which for a custom relationship ends in __r (typically Job_Applications__r), and the filter on the Contact's parent Account uses the lookup name Account.Industry. Note: none of the printed options is valid SOQL; Accounts.Industry is not a valid path and Job_Application__c or Job_Application_s cannot be used in a subquery. The standard version of this question's answer is [SELECT Id, (SELECT Id FROM Job_Applications__r) FROM Contact WHERE Account.Industry = 'Technology'].
reviewNote: Source text is garbled; no printed option is valid SOQL and the key D (Job_Application_s with Accounts.Industry) is not correct. Standard answer is (SELECT Id FROM Job_Applications__r) ... WHERE Account.Industry = 'Technology'.

text:
A developer must implement a CheckPaymentProcessor class that provides check processing payment capabilities that adhere to what is defined for payments in the PaymentProcessor interface. 
public interface PaymentProcessor{
    void pay(Decimal amount);
}
Which implementation is correct to use the PaymentProcessor interface?

options.text:
public class CheckPaymentProcessor implements PaymentProcessor {
    public void pay(Decimal amount) {}
}

public class CheckPaymentProcessor implements PaymentProcessor {
    public void pay(Decimal amount);
}

public class CheckPaymentProcessor extends PaymentProcessor {
    public void pay(Decimal amount);
}

public class CheckPaymentProcessor extends PaymentProcessor {
    public void pay(Decimal amount) {}
}

explanation: A class uses an interface with implements and must give every interface method a body, so implements PaymentProcessor with public void pay(Decimal amount) {} is correct. Declaring pay without a body is only allowed in an interface or as an abstract method, and extends is for inheriting from a virtual or abstract class, not for implementing an interface.

text: A developer must write an Apex method that will be called from a Lightning component. The method may delete an Account stored in the accountRec variable. Which method should a developer use to ensure only users that should be able to delete Accounts can successfully perform deletions?

options.text: accountRec.isDeleteable()
Schema.sObjectType.Account.isDeleteable()
Account.isDeleteable()
accountRec.sObjectType.isDeleteable()

explanation: Object-level permissions are checked through the describe result for the object, Schema.sObjectType.Account.isDeletable(), which returns whether the running user has delete access to Accounts. The method is not available on a record instance, on the bare Account type token, or through accountRec.sObjectType. Note that the actual method name is spelled isDeletable().

text: A developer creates a Lightning web component that imports a method within an Apex class. When a Validate button is pressed, the method runs to execute complex validations. In this implementation scenario, which two options are part of the Controller according to the MVC architecture?

options.text: JavaScript file
XML file
Apex class
HTML file

explanation: In an LWC, the JavaScript file handles events such as the Validate button click and calls the imported Apex method, and the Apex class runs the validation logic on the server. Both act as the Controller layer. The HTML template is the View, and the XML configuration file only describes metadata such as where the component can be used.

text: A developer writes a trigger on the Account object on the before update event that increments a count field. A record triggered flow also increments the count field every time that an Account is created or updated. What is the value of the count field if an Account is inserted with an initial value of zero, assuming no other automation logic is implemented on the Account?
explanation: On insert, only the record-triggered flow runs, because the trigger listens to before update and does not fire when a record is created. A before-save flow changes the field values in memory without another DML update, so the count goes from 0 to 1 and no update event re-fires the trigger. The higher values would require the insert to cause an extra update cycle.

text: Universal Containers (UC) uses out-of-the-box order management, that has a Master-Detail relationship between Order and Order Line Item. Which method should be used to calculate the estimated ship date for an Order?

options.text: Use a LATEST formula on each of the latest availability date fields.
Use a DAYS formula on each of the availability date fields and a COUNT Roll Up Summary field on the Order.
Use a MAX Roll-Up Summary field on the latest availability date fields.
Use a CEILING formula on each of the latest availability date fields.

explanation: The Order can only ship when its last line item is available, so the estimated ship date is the latest availability date among its line items. Because of the master-detail relationship, a MAX roll-up summary field on the Order can compute that declaratively. LATEST and DAYS aren't formula functions for this purpose, a COUNT roll-up only counts records, and CEILING rounds numbers rather than finding the latest date.

text: When importing and exporting data into Salesforce, which two statements are true?

options.text: Bulk API can be used to import large data volumes in development environments without bypassing the storage limits.
Data import wizard is an application that is installed on your computer.
Bulk API can be used to bypass the storage limits when importing large data volumes in development environments.
Development and Developer Pro sandboxes have different storage limits.

explanation: Bulk API is designed to load large data volumes asynchronously, but every record still counts against the org's data storage, so it cannot bypass storage limits. Developer sandboxes have 200 MB of data storage while Developer Pro sandboxes have 1 GB, so their limits differ. The Data Import Wizard runs in the browser from Setup and is not installed locally; Data Loader is the client application.

text: Which three code lines are required to create a Lightning component on a Visualforce page?

options.text: $Lightning.createComponent
<apex:includeLightning/>
$Lightning.use
$Lightning.useComponent
<apex:slds/>

explanation: Lightning Components for Visualforce requires <apex:includeLightning/> to load the Lightning Out library, $Lightning.use() to reference a Lightning dependency app, and $Lightning.createComponent() inside its callback to create the component in a DOM element. $Lightning.useComponent does not exist, and <apex:slds/> only adds SLDS styling, so it is not required.

text: Which two statements are true about using the @TestSetup annotation in an Apex test class?

options.text: In a test setup method, test data is inserted once and made available for all test methods in the test class.
Records created in the test setup method cannot be updated in individual test methods.
A method defined with the @testSetup annotation executes once for each test method in the test class and counts towards system limits.
The @testSetup annotation is not supported when the @isTest(SeeAllData=True) annotation is used.

explanation: A @testSetup method runs once per test class, and the records it creates are available to every test method; each method gets a fresh copy because changes are rolled back after it runs. Test setup methods are not supported in classes annotated with @isTest(SeeAllData=true). Test methods can freely update the setup records, and the setup method does not re-run for each test method.

text: A Next Best Action strategy uses an Enhance element that invokes an Apex method to determine a discount level for a Contact, based on a number of factors. What is the correct definition of the Apex method?

options.text: @InvocableMethod global static List<Recommendation> getLevel(List<ContactWrapper> input) { /*implementation*/ }
@InvocableMethod global List<List<Recommendation>> getLevel(List<ContactWrapper> input) { /*implementation*/ }
@InvocableMethod global Recommendation getLevel(ContactWrapper input) { /*implementation*/ }
@InvocableMethod global static List<List<Recommendation>> getLevel(List<ContactWrapper> input) { /*implementation*/ }

explanation: An Enhance element calls an invocable method that receives a list of inputs and returns a list of recommendation lists, one inner list per input, so the signature must return List<List<Recommendation>>. Invocable methods must also be static. The option returning List<Recommendation> has the wrong return shape, the non-static version is invalid, and an invocable method can't take or return single non-list values.

text: A developer is migrating a Visualforce page into a Lightning web component. The Visualforce page shows information about a single record. The developer decides to use Lightning Data Service to access record data. Which security consideration should the developer be aware of?

options.text: The 'isAccessible()' method must be used for field-level access checks.
Lightning Data Service handles sharing rules and field-level security.
The 'with sharing' keyword must be used to enforce sharing rules.
Lightning Data Service ignores field-level security.

explanation: Lightning Data Service runs in the user's context and automatically respects sharing rules, CRUD, and field-level security, so the developer doesn't need to write manual access checks. isAccessible() checks and the with sharing keyword apply to Apex code, which LDS doesn't require. LDS does not ignore field-level security; inaccessible fields simply aren't returned.

text: A developer creates a batch Apex job to update a large number of records and receives reports of the job timing out and not completing. What is the first step towards troubleshooting the issue?

options.text: Check the asynchronous job monitoring page to view the job status and logs.
Check the debug logs for the batch job.
Disable the batch job and recreate it with a smaller number of records.
Decrease the batch size to reduce the load on the system.

explanation: The Apex Jobs page in Setup shows the job's status, how many batches were processed, how many failed, and the first error message, so it is the first place to understand what is happening. Debug logs are useful afterwards but must be enabled and can be hard to capture for batches. Recreating the job or changing the batch size are fixes that should come after the cause is identified.

text: What are two benefits of using External IDs?

options.text: An External ID field can be used to reference an ID from another external system.
An External ID can be a formula field to help create a unique key from two fields in Salesforce.
An External ID can be used with Salesforce Mobile to make external data visible.
An External ID is indexed and can improve the performance of SOQL queries.

explanation: An External ID stores a record's identifier from another system, enabling matching and upsert operations during integrations and imports. External ID fields are also automatically indexed, so filtering on them in SOQL performs better. Formula fields cannot be marked as External IDs, and an External ID does not make external data visible in Salesforce Mobile; that is the job of Salesforce Connect external objects.

text: A developer completed modifications to a customized feature that is comprised of two elements: - Apex trigger - Trigger handler Apex class What are two factors that the developer must take into account to properly deploy the modification to the production environment?

options.text: All methods in the test classes must use 'assert'.
At least one line of code must be executed for the Apex trigger.
At least 75% of Apex code must be covered by unit tests.
The Apex trigger must be included in a Change Set.

explanation: Exam key: assertions in every test method and 75% coverage. Deploying Apex to production requires at least 75% of Apex code to be covered by tests, and all tests must pass. Note: Salesforce does not require assertions for deployment (they are a best practice), but it does require every trigger to have some coverage, meaning at least one line must execute; the documented answer is 75% coverage plus trigger coverage. A change set is only one of several deployment tools.
reviewNote: Key appears incorrect: asserts aren't required to deploy; documented requirements are 75% overall coverage and at least 1% (one line) trigger coverage (B, C).

text: A developer needs to make a custom Lightning Web Component available in the Salesforce Classic user interface. Which approach can be used to accomplish this?

options.text: Wrap the Lightning Web Component in an Aura Component and surface the Aura Component as a Visualforce tab.
Embed the Lightning Web Component in a Visualforce Component and add directly to the page layout.
Use a Visualforce page with a custom controller to invoke the Lightning Web Component using a call to an Apex method.
Use the Lightning Out JavaScript library to embed the Lightning Web Component in a Visualforce page and add to the page layout.

explanation: Exam key: a Visualforce page with a custom controller that invokes the component through Apex. Note: an Apex method cannot render a UI component. Salesforce documents Lightning Components for Visualforce, built on Lightning Out, which uses $Lightning.use() and $Lightning.createComponent() to embed an LWC in a Visualforce page that can then be added to a Classic page layout. A Visualforce tab can only show a Visualforce page, and Visualforce components can't host an LWC directly.
reviewNote: Key appears incorrect: the documented approach is Lightning Out in a Visualforce page (D); Apex can't render an LWC.

text: A developer wants to improve runtime performance of Apex calls by caching results on the client. What is the most efficient way to implement this and follow best practices?

options.text: Call the 'setStorable()' method on the action in the JavaScript client-side code.
Decorate the server-side method with '@AuraEnabled(storable=true)'.
Decorate the server-side method with '@AuraEnabled(cacheable=true)'.
Set a cookie in the browser for use upon return to the page.

explanation: Annotating the Apex method with @AuraEnabled(cacheable=true) lets the Lightning framework cache the response on the client, so repeated calls with the same parameters are served from cache. This is required for @wire and is the recommended approach for both LWC and Aura. setStorable() is the older Aura-only way to mark an action as storable, storable=true is not a valid annotation parameter, and cookies are not a suitable data cache.
reviewNote: Restored option text: source printed '@AuraEnabled(cachedAlert=true)' and '@AuraEnabled(storable=true)' for the standard storable=true / cacheable=true options; keyed C now reads cacheable=true.

text:
A lead developer creates a virtual class called "OrderRequest". Consider the following code snippet: 
public class CustomerOrder {
    //code implementation
}
How can a developer use the OrderRequest class within the CustomerOrder class?

options.text: public class CustomerOrder implements Order
public class CustomerOrder extends OrderRequest
@Extends(class="OrderRequest") public class CustomerOrder
@Implements(class="OrderRequest") public class CustomerOrder

explanation: Exam key: public class CustomerOrder implements Order. Note: implements is only for interfaces, and no Order interface is described. In Apex, a class inherits from a virtual or abstract class with the extends keyword, so the documented answer is public class CustomerOrder extends OrderRequest. Apex has no @Extends or @Implements annotations.
reviewNote: Key appears incorrect: a virtual class is used via 'extends OrderRequest' (B), not 'implements Order'.

text: The Account object in an organization has a master-detail relationship to a child object called Branch. The following automations exist: - Roll-up summary fields - Custom validation rules - Duplicate rules A developer created a trigger on the Account object. Which two things should the developer consider while testing the trigger code?

options.text: The validation rules will cause the trigger to fire again.
Rollup summary fields can cause the parent record to go through Save.
The trigger may fire multiple times during a transaction.
Duplicate rules are executed once all DML operations commit to the database.

explanation: When a Branch record changes, the roll-up summary field on Account is recalculated and the parent Account goes through its own save procedure, which fires the Account trigger again. Combined with workflow or flow updates, the trigger can run several times in one transaction, so it should be written to handle recursion. Validation rules don't re-fire triggers, and duplicate rules run before the record is saved, not after commit.

text: Which Lightning Web Component custom event property settings enable the event to bubble up the containment hierarchy and cross the Shadow DOM boundary?

options.text: bubbles: true, composed: true
bubbles: true, composed: false
bubbles: false, composed: false
bubbles: false, composed: true

explanation: bubbles: true makes the event propagate up through the DOM tree, and composed: true lets it cross shadow boundaries into the containing components. Both are needed for an event to bubble up the full containment hierarchy. bubbles: true, composed: false stays inside the component's own shadow tree, false/false reaches only the immediate parent, and bubbles: false, composed: true is not a supported configuration in LWC.

text: An org has an existing flow that edits an Opportunity with an Update Records element. A developer must update the flow to also create a Contact and store the created Contact's ID on the Opportunity. Which update must the developer make in the flow?

options.text: Add a new Update Records element.
Add a new Create Records element.
Add a new Get Records element.
Add a new Roll Back Records element.

explanation: A Create Records element inserts the Contact and can store the new record's Id in a variable. That Id can then be set on the Opportunity in the existing Update Records element, so no second update is needed. Another Update Records element can't create a Contact, Get Records only queries existing data, and Roll Back Records undoes pending changes.

text: Which three data types can a SOQL query return?

options.text: Object
Double
Long
List
Integer

explanation: A SOQL query returns a List<sObject>, a single sObject record when the result is assigned to an sObject variable (the "Object" choice here), or an Integer when the query uses SELECT COUNT(). SOQL never returns Double or Long directly; aggregate functions such as SUM() return AggregateResult objects instead.

text: A team of developers is working on a source-driven project that allows them to work independently, with many different org configurations. Which type of Salesforce orgs should they use for their development?

options.text: Developer sandboxes
Developer orgs
Scratch orgs
Full Copy sandboxes

explanation: Scratch orgs are temporary, source-driven orgs created from a Dev Hub with the Salesforce CLI, and each can use a different configuration defined in a scratch org definition file. That makes them ideal for developers working independently on many configurations. Sandboxes are copies of production and are slower to create and less flexible, and standalone Developer Edition orgs are not tied to a source-driven workflow.

text: Which two are best practices when it comes to Aura component and application event handling?

options.text: Reuse the event logic in a component bundle, by putting the logic in the helper.
Handle low-level events in the event handler and re-fire them as higher-level events.
Try to use application events as opposed to component events.
Use component events to communicate actions that should be handled at the application level.

explanation: Salesforce recommends putting shared event logic in the helper so multiple handlers in the bundle can reuse it, and handling low-level events such as clicks in a handler that then fires a more meaningful, higher-level event. Component events should be preferred over application events, since application events broadcast to everything. Actions that the application must handle should use application events, not component events.

text: Universal Containers has implemented an order management application. Each Order can have one or more Order Line items. The Order Line object is related to the Order via a master-detail relationship. For each Order Line item, the total price is calculated by multiplying the Order Line item price with the quantity ordered. What is the best practice to get the sum of all Order Line item totals on the Order record?

options.text: Roll-up summary field
Formula field
Quick action
Apex trigger

explanation: Because Order Line is the detail in a master-detail relationship, a SUM roll-up summary field on Order can total the line-item total formula field declaratively, with no code. A formula field cannot aggregate child records, a quick action doesn't calculate values, and an Apex trigger would be unnecessary custom code for something the platform already provides.

text: What are three considerations when using the @InvocableMethod annotation in Apex?

options.text: Only one method using the @InvocableMethod annotation can be defined per Apex class.
A method using the @InvocableMethod annotation must be declared as static.
A method using the @InvocableMethod annotation can be declared as Public or Global.
A method using the @InvocableMethod annotation can have multiple input parameters.
A method using the @InvocableMethod annotation must define a return value.

explanation: Only one method per Apex class can carry @InvocableMethod. It must be static, and it can be public or global. It takes at most one input parameter (usually a List of a primitive, sObject, or @InvocableVariable wrapper type), and the return value is optional, so it can return void.

text: What should be used to create scratch orgs?

options.text: Workbench
Salesforce CLI
Developer Console
Sandbox refresh

explanation: Scratch orgs are created from a Dev Hub-enabled org using the Salesforce CLI, for example sf org create scratch with a scratch org definition file. Workbench and the Developer Console are browser tools for querying and coding in an existing org, and a sandbox refresh only re-copies a sandbox from production.

text: Universal Containers (UC) processes orders in Salesforce in a custom object, Order__c. They also allow sales reps to upload CSV files with thousands of orders at a time. A developer is tasked with integrating orders placed in Salesforce with UC's enterprise resource planning (ERP) system. After the status for an Order__c is first set to 'Placed', the order information must be sent to a REST endpoint in the ERP system that can process one order at a time. What should the developer implement to accomplish this?

options.text: Callout from a queueable class called from a trigger
Callout from a batchable class called from a scheduled job
Flow with a callout from an invocable method
Callout from an instantaneous method called from a trigger

explanation: Triggers can't make synchronous callouts, so the trigger should detect the status change to 'Placed' and enqueue a Queueable class marked Database.AllowsCallouts, which can send each order to the ERP and chain further jobs for bulk uploads. A scheduled batch adds delay rather than reacting when the status is set, and a flow with an invocable callout runs in the same transaction. A synchronous callout directly from a trigger is not allowed.

text: A developer needs to implement a custom SOAP Web Service that is used by an external Web Application. The developer chooses to include helper methods that are not used by the Web Application in the implementation of the Web Service Class. Which code segment shows the correct declaration of the class and methods?

options.text: global class webserviceclass { private static Boolean betweenhead() { /*implementation*/ } global string updateheader() { /*implementation*/ } }
webservice class webserviceclass { private static Boolean betweenhead() { /*implementation*/ } global static String updateheader() { /*implementation*/ } }
webservice class webserviceclass { private static Boolean betweenhead() { /*implementation*/ } webservice static String updateheader() { /*implementation*/ } }
global class webserviceclass { private static Boolean betweenhead() { /*implementation*/ } webservice static String updateheader() { /*implementation*/ } }

explanation: Exam key: webservice class with a webservice static method. Note: Apex SOAP web services must be declared in a global class, and webservice is a method (or member) modifier, not a class modifier; exposed methods must be webservice static. Helper methods can stay private. The documented correct form is global class webserviceclass with a private helper and a webservice static String updateheader() method.
reviewNote: Key appears incorrect: 'webservice class' is invalid; SOAP services need a global class with webservice static methods (D). Option D was truncated in the source and was completed with the standard wording.

text: How should a developer write unit tests for a private method in an Apex class?

options.text: Use the @TestVisible annotation.
Add a test method in the Apex class.
Mark the Apex class as global.
Use the @TestSetup annotation.

explanation: Annotating a private method or variable with @TestVisible makes it accessible to test classes without changing its visibility for other code. Test methods can't be defined in non-test classes, marking the class global doesn't expose private members, and @TestSetup only creates shared test data.

text: What is the value of the Trigger.old context variable in a before insert trigger?

options.text: An empty list of sObjects
Undefined
Null
A list of newly created sObjects without IDs

explanation: Exam key: an empty list of sObjects. Note: per the Apex trigger documentation, Trigger.old is only available in update and delete triggers, and in insert triggers it is null rather than an empty list. The newly created records without Ids are in Trigger.new, and Apex has no "undefined" value.
reviewNote: Key appears incorrect: Trigger.old is null in insert triggers (C), not an empty list.

text: Universal Containers decided to transition from Classic to Lightning Experience. They asked a developer to replace a JavaScript button that was being used to create records with prepopulated values. What can the developer use to accomplish this?

options.text: Validation rules
Apex Triggers
Record triggered flows
Quick Actions

explanation: JavaScript buttons aren't supported in Lightning Experience, and Salesforce recommends replacing ones that create records with Create a Record quick actions, which support predefined field values. Validation rules, Apex triggers, and record-triggered flows run on save and can't present a button that opens a prefilled create form.

text: Universal Containers has developed custom Apex code and Lightning Components in a Sandbox environment. They need to deploy the code and associated configurations to the Production environment. What is the recommended process for deploying the code and configurations to Production?

options.text: Use the Force.com IDE to deploy the Apex code and Lightning Components.
Use the Ant Migration Tool to deploy the Apex code and Lightning Components.
Use a change set to deploy the Apex code and Lightning Components.
Use Salesforce CLI to deploy the Apex code and Lightning Components.

explanation: Change sets are the built-in, point-and-click way to move code and configuration from a sandbox to its related production org, and they bundle Apex, Lightning components, and associated metadata together. The Force.com IDE is retired and the Ant Migration Tool is a legacy script-based option. The Salesforce CLI also works, but it is suited to source-driven development rather than the sandbox-to-production scenario described.

text: Universal Containers has a Visualforce page that displays a table of every Container__c being rented by a given Account. Recently this page is failing with a view state limit because some of the customers rent over 10,000 containers. What should a developer change about the Visualforce page to help with the page load errors?

options.text: Implement pagination with an OffsetController.
Implement pagination with a Standard SetController.
Use JavaScript remoting with SOQL Offset.
Use lazy loading and a transient List variable.

explanation: ApexPages.StandardSetController provides built-in pagination, keeping only one page of records in view state and handling up to 10,000 records. That directly addresses the view state failure. There is no OffsetController class, SOQL OFFSET tops out at 2,000 rows, and a transient list would avoid view state but require re-querying everything on each request.

text: A developer created a trigger on a custom object. This custom object also has some dependent picklists. According to the order of execution rules, which step happens first?

options.text: The original record is loaded from the database.
System validation is run for maximum field lengths.
Old values are overwritten with the new record values.
JavaScript validation is run in the browser.

explanation: When a record has dependent picklist fields, the browser runs JavaScript validation on them before the save is sent to the server. Only then does the server load the original record (or initialize a new one), overwrite old values with the new ones, and run system validations such as maximum field length.

text: Universal Containers implemented a private sharing model for the Account object. A custom Account search tool was developed with Apex to help sales representatives find accounts that match multiple criteria they specify. Since its release, users of the tool report they can see Accounts they do not own. What should the developer use to enforce sharing permissions for the currently logged in user while using the custom search tool?

options.text: Use the 'with sharing' keyword on the class declaration.
Use the 'without sharing' keyword on the class declaration.
Use the Schema class to filter all SOQL queries to return records owned by the logged-in user.
Use the Schema describe calls to determine if the logged-in user has access to the Account object.

explanation: Declaring the class with sharing makes its SOQL queries respect the running user's record-level access, so the tool returns only Accounts the user can see. without sharing explicitly ignores sharing. The Schema class doesn't filter query results, and describe calls only check object- and field-level permissions, not record sharing.

text: Universal Containers is building a recruiting app with an Applicant object that stores information about an individual person and a Job object that represents a job. Each applicant may apply for more than one job. What should a developer implement to represent that an applicant has applied for a job?

options.text: Junction object between Applicant and Job
Lookup field from Applicant to Job
Master-detail field from Applicant to Job
Formula field on Applicant that references Job

explanation: An applicant can apply to many jobs and a job has many applicants, which is a many-to-many relationship. Salesforce models that with a junction object, such as Application, that has relationships to both Applicant and Job. A single lookup or master-detail field on Applicant can point to only one Job, and a formula field can't create a relationship.

text: A business has a proprietary Order Management System (OMS) that creates orders from its website and fulfills the orders. When the order is created in the OMS, an integration also creates an order record in Salesforce and relates it to the contact as identified by the email on the order. As the order goes through different stages in the OMS, the integration also updates it in Salesforce. The business notices that each update from the OMS creates a new order record in Salesforce. Which two actions should prevent the duplicate order records from being created in Salesforce?

options.text: Use the order number from the OMS as an external ID.
Ensure that the order number in the OMS is unique.
Use the email on the contact record as an external ID.
Write a trigger on the Order object to delete the duplicates.

explanation: Storing the OMS order number in an External ID field lets the integration upsert on it, so updates match the existing order instead of inserting a new one. That only works if the order number is unique in the OMS. A contact's email identifies a person, not an order, so it can't tell one order from another. A trigger deleting duplicates treats the symptom instead of preventing it.

text: Managers at Universal Containers want to ensure that only decommissioned containers are able to be deleted in the system. To meet the business requirement a Salesforce developer adds "Decommissioned" as a picklist value for the Status__c custom field within the Container__c object. Which two approaches could a developer use to enforce only Container records with a status of "Decommissioned" can be deleted?

options.text: Before-delete record-triggered flow
Before-delete Apex trigger
After-delete record-triggered flow
Validation rule

explanation: Exam key: before-delete Apex trigger and after-delete record-triggered flow. A before-delete Apex trigger can call addError() on records whose Status__c isn't Decommissioned to block the deletion. Note: an after-delete flow runs only after the record is gone and can't stop it; a record-triggered flow set to run when a record is deleted runs before the delete and its Custom Error element can block it, so the documented answer is the before-delete flow and the Apex trigger. Validation rules don't run on delete.
reviewNote: Source options garbled ('Seller record triggers flow', 'After querying', 'After record triggers flow', 'Validate rule'); restored to the standard wording. Key appears incorrect: an after-delete flow can't block deletion; documented answer is before-delete flow + Apex trigger (A, B).

text: Universal Containers wants a list button to display a Visualforce page that allows users to edit multiple records. Which Visualforce feature supports this requirement?

options.text: Standard Controller with Custom List Controller extension
Custom List Controller with recordSetVar page attribute
Controller Extension and <apex:button> tag
Standard controller and the recordSetVar page attribute

explanation: Setting standardController together with the recordSetVar attribute on <apex:page> activates the standard list controller, which works on a set of selected records and makes the page available as a list button. A custom list controller doesn't use recordSetVar, and a controller extension with a button doesn't by itself provide record-set handling. <apex:button> isn't a Visualforce tag.

text: A developer creates a new Apex trigger with a helper class, and writes a test class that only exercises 95% coverage of the new Apex helper class. Change Set deployment to production fails with the test coverage warning: "Test coverage of selected Apex Trigger is 0%, at least 1% test coverage is required." What should the developer do to successfully deploy the new Apex trigger and helper class?

options.text: Increase the test class coverage on the helper class.
Create a test class and methods to cover the Apex trigger.
Remove the failing test methods from the test class.
Run the tests using the 'Run All Tests' method.

explanation: Every trigger needs at least some coverage to deploy, and the error shows the trigger itself is never executed by the tests. The fix is a test that performs DML on the object so the trigger fires. More helper-class coverage doesn't cover the trigger, no tests are failing to remove, and running all tests doesn't change trigger coverage.

text: A developer is designing a new application on the Salesforce platform and wants to ensure it can support multiple tenants effectively. Which design framework should the developer consider to ensure scalability and maintainability?

options.text: Waterfall Model
MVC (Model-View-Controller)
Model-View-Composite (MVC)
Agile Development

explanation: Model-View-Controller separates data (objects), presentation (pages and components), and logic (controllers and Apex), which fits the metadata-driven multitenant platform and keeps applications scalable and maintainable. Waterfall and Agile are project-management methodologies, not application design frameworks, and "Model-View-Composite" isn't a recognized pattern.

text: What should a developer use to obtain the Id and Name of all the Leads, Accounts, and Contracts that have the company name "Universal Containers"?

options.text: FIND 'Universal Containers' IN ALL FIELDS RETURNING Lead(Id, Name), Account(Id, Name), Contract(Id, Name)
FIND 'Lead(Id, Name), Account(Id, Name), Contract(Id, Name)' FROM SALA WHERE Name = 'Universal Containers'
FIND 'Universal Containers' IN Name Fields RETURNING Lead(Id, Name), Account(Id, Name), Contract(Id, Name)
FIND 'Lead(Id, Name), Account(Id, Name), Contract(Id, Name)' FROM Lead, Account, Contract WHERE Name = 'Universal Containers'

explanation: SOSL searches several objects in one call. FIND 'Universal Containers' IN ALL FIELDS RETURNING ... searches every searchable field, so it matches the company name wherever it is stored, such as the Lead's Company field or the Account name, and returns the Id and Name from each object. The options that put a field list in FIND and use FROM/WHERE mix SOQL and SOSL syntax and are invalid.

text: What are two considerations for running a flow in debug mode?

options.text: Configure external registers as set command when debugging a flow.
Use open-source and parallel tasks where the debugging ends.
Input variable of type record cannot be passed into the flow.
Clicking Pause or executing a Pause element closes the flow and ends debugging.

explanation: Salesforce lists debug considerations including that clicking Pause or reaching a Pause element closes the flow and ends the debug run, and that some input variable types, such as records, can't be set as inputs from the debug dialog. The other two statements are not real Flow Builder concepts and don't describe debug behavior.

text: Since Aura application events follow the traditional publish-subscribe model, which method is used to fire an event?

options.text: fire()
replaceState()
startOut()
publish()

explanation: In Aura, you get an application event with $A.get("e.namespace:eventName"), set its parameters, and call fire() to broadcast it to every registered handler. publish() belongs to Lightning Message Service, not Aura events, while replaceState() and startOut() aren't Aura event methods.

text: What does the Lightning Component framework provide to developers?

options.text: Prebuilt components that can be reused.
Extended governor limits for applications.
Support for Classic and Lightning UIs.
Templates to create custom components.

explanation: The Lightning Component framework ships a library of prebuilt, reusable base components, such as buttons, inputs, and data tables, so developers can assemble apps quickly. It doesn't raise governor limits or provide templates for creating components. Lightning components are built for Lightning Experience and the mobile app, not as a way to support the Classic UI.
reviewNote: Restored garbled options to the standard wording (source: 'Prebuilt Components that will be tested', 'Extended sparsely inside for applications', 'Support for Course and Lightning IDs', 'Forfeited to create custom components').

text: What are three characteristics of change set deployments?

options.text: Change sets can only be used between related organizations.
Deployment is done in a one-way, single transaction.
Change sets can be used to transfer records.
Sending a change set between two orgs requires a deployment connection.
Change sets can deploy custom settings data.

explanation: Change sets only move metadata between related orgs (production and its sandboxes). The target org must authorize a deployment connection before an outbound change set can be uploaded. Each deployment goes one way in a single transaction that either fully succeeds or rolls back. Change sets carry metadata only, so neither records nor custom settings data can be transferred with them.
